dct_description_sm: Black-and-white cadastral map of South Crookston in Polk County, Minnesota, including the Sampson's Woodland addition. Features such as parks and rivers are represented pictorially.; "For Lots and Blocks in South Crookston apply to or address Stenerson & McManus, Broadway, south of U.S. Land Office, Crookston, Minn.; J. N. Ives & Son, Broadway, opp. U.S. Land Office, Crookston, Minn.; Palmer & Bond, Robert Street, Crookston, Minn.; Office of the Crookston Improvement Co., Main St., opp. Merchants Bank, Crookston, Minn.; or A. E. Johnson & Co., St. Paul, Minn."; Certificate of authenticity from Barry Lawrence Ruderman Antique Maps Inc., La Jolla, Calif.
